facts.fact: The World Bank ICR records, as a prior action of the second Inclusive Growth DPO, that the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection had operationalized an Integrated Management Information System (IMIS), evidenced by a user acceptance test and MIS deployment notes.
The World Bank ICR says the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection's IMIS was operationalized to implement and coordinate the social programs of participating institutions.
